title: Added optional file_path argument
description:
I removed libraries json and pathlib that weren't being used and added optional file_path argument to .get_date and the required tt_download function and method so that users can download the file(s) to directories of their choosing.

Seems like a good change to add the the other function .get_week and tt_download_file, but I didn't feel like changing that (yet). 

I tested the use cases for downloading without the argument, using relative paths ("./filepath/") and full file file paths, but only in Unix like environments (not Windows), obviously you'll want to test it as well.
